searchData.contentSummary: Generic second-site contact page used to verify that form submissions are stored for the resolved Pumpkin CMS tenant.

content.headline: Request a Second Product Rental Quote
content.subheadline: Submit a local proof request to confirm that the same frontend can save form entries for a separate tenant.

content.title: Start a proof quote request
content.subtitle: Use generic details only. This form is for local second-tenant proof testing.
content.hours: Local proof responses are not monitored.

formFields.label: Proof Notes
formFields.placeholder: Add generic notes for the local proof submission

content.title: What to verify after submitting
content.subtitle: The form should save a new FormEntry document for the second tenant.

cards.title: Resolved tenant
cards.description: Confirm the submission is associated with second-product-rentals.

cards.title: Form fields
cards.description: Confirm the CMS-driven labels and submitted values are captured.

cards.title: No secrets
cards.description: Confirm the browser never receives the plain Pumpkin API key from server config.

content.title: Contact proof questions
content.subtitle: Use this page only for local second-tenant testing.

items.question: Should I use real customer information?
items.answer: No. Use generic local test details only.

items.question: Where should the entry appear?
items.answer: After a successful submission, check the FormEntry container and confirm the tenantId belongs to the second tenant.

items.question: Does the form expose the API key?
items.answer: No. The frontend route should keep the Pumpkin API key server-side and forward the request from the app server.

content.title: Need to review the proof page first?
content.description: Open the second product rental page to confirm CMS content and navigation before submitting a form.
